title.zh: 中国的疆域与行政区划

clips.send: Location. Eastern + Northern Hemispheres, East Asia, west coast of the Pacific. Hemispheres: China is in both the Eastern and the Northern Hemisphere. Land–sea position: in eastern Asia, on the west coast of the Pacific Ocean. The east faces the ocean, the west reaches deep into Eurasia. Latitude: it spans nearly 50° of latitude. Most of China is in the north temperate zone, a small southern part is in the tropics, and none is in a frigid zone. The Tropic of Cancer (23.5°N) crosses Taiwan, Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan. Advantages: land and sea both help transport and links with the world; mostly temperate, so the climate suits farming and living. Tropic of Cancer, east, west: Taiwan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan (台粤桂滇).

clips.send: Shanxi. Short name 晋. Capital: Taiyuan. On the Loess Plateau; very rich in coal.
clips.text: Shanxi. Short name 晋. Capital: Taiyuan. On the Loess Plateau; very rich in coal.

clips.send: Qinghai. Short name 青. Capital: Xining. Source of the Yangtze and Yellow rivers; Qinghai Lake is China’s largest saltwater lake.
clips.text: Qinghai. Short name 青. Capital: Xining. Source of the Yangtze and Yellow rivers; Qinghai Lake is China’s largest saltwater lake.

clips.send: Shandong. Short name 鲁. Capital: Jinan. The Shandong Peninsula reaches out between the Bohai and Yellow Seas; the Yellow River enters the sea here.
clips.text: Shandong. Short name 鲁. Capital: Jinan. The Shandong Peninsula reaches out between the Bohai and Yellow Seas; the Yellow River enters the sea here.

clips.send: Seas and sea neighbours. Mainland coastline over 18,000 km. From north to south China borders the Bohai, Yellow, East China and South China Seas. The Bohai Sea and the Qiongzhou Strait are China’s inland seas. The South China Sea is the largest and deepest. More than 5400 islands: Taiwan Island is the largest, Hainan Island is second. The South China Sea Islands (Dongsha, Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha) belong to Hainan Province. Six countries face China across the sea: South Korea, Japan, the Philippines, Malaysia, Brunei and Indonesia. Seas north, south: 渤, 黄, 东, 南. Sea neighbours: 韩日菲, 马文印（尼）.

clips.send: Jiangsu. Short name 苏. Capital: Nanjing. Low and flat with many rivers and lakes; crossed by the Yangtze and Huai rivers.

clips.send: 地理位置。 东半球、北半球 · 亚洲东部 · 太平洋西岸。 半球位置：位于东半球和北半球。。 海陆位置：位于亚洲东部、太平洋西岸，东临海洋，西深入亚欧大陆内部。。 纬度位置：南北跨纬度近 50 度 ，大部分位于北温带，小部分位于热带，没有寒带。。 北回归线穿过我国南部的台湾、广东、广西、云南。。 优越性：海陆兼备，便于海陆交通和对外联系；大部分在温带，气候适宜。。 北回归线自东向西穿过：台、粤、桂、滇。

clips.send: 海域与隔海邻国。 大陆海岸线长 1.8 万多千米。 我国东部和南部大陆海岸线濒临的海，从北到南依次是渤海、黄海、东海和南海。。 渤海和琼州海峡是我国的内海；南海面积最大，也最深。。 我国有 5400 多个岛屿，台湾岛最大，海南岛其次。。 南海诸岛（东沙、西沙、中沙、南沙群岛）属于海南省。。 隔海相望的国家有 6 个：韩国、日本、菲律宾、马来西亚、文莱、印度尼西亚。。 四海从北到南：渤、黄、东、南；隔海六国：韩日菲，马文印（尼）。
